issues.summary: The complete staged RO map initially failed to transition from init_game to in_game through the standard SC2 API path.
issues.impact: The stale launcher packaging path prevented native commander and AI ally verification until the launcher was corrected.
issues.nextAction: Keep the strict native census and StormLib packaging path as regression gates.

issues.summary: Twenty-four RO maps still contain dynamically resolved owners or alliance expressions that the safe adapter cannot authorize statically.
issues.impact: The adapter may expose fewer runtime targets than the mission creates, but it will not infer allies or enemies from unresolved values.
issues.nextAction: Capture native owner/alliance state for representative maps after RO reaches in_game; do not widen the contract before that evidence exists.

issues.summary: The earlier thorner03 bootstrap window stopped before the map-owned Tychus rescue, but the later no-debug Stage 09 runtime window observed the same-tag P2 handover end to end.
issues.impact: The old evidence was insufficient for the AI ally claim, but it is superseded by a current map-owned rescue observation with P2 ownership, P1-visible alliance, and a clean same-window ScriptError verdict.
issues.resolution: Stage 09 ran the unchanged no-debug p2_handover_probe.py through the approved launcher and observed Odin moving from owner 16/alliance 3 to owner 2/alliance 2 after the map-owned Region 24 handover.

issues.summary: The former RO-specific API probe accepted a no-error JoinGame response without requiring status=in_game.
issues.impact: Strict response-state checks now prevent a listener or launched-only state from being reported as a playable runtime pass.
issues.nextAction: Keep strict CreateGame/JoinGame/RequestStep assertions in every future native run.

issues.summary: The direct-map Revolution Overdrive launcher could exit before SC2_x64 became visible after SC2Switcher returned.
issues.impact: WebUI launches could be reported as ready-timeout failures even though SC2 was still starting and later produced the map-load log.
issues.nextAction: Keep the bounded startup grace and same-window Alert/ScriptError gates in future direct-map launcher changes.

issues.summary: The pure-runtime thanson01 Iron window reached the map-owned Escort transition and observed the runtime-replaced worker and fortress.
issues.impact: None for the thanson01/Iron commander-map pairing. The opening SCV remains map-owned and is replaced by runtime Galaxy after creation/ownership lifecycle events; the base is likewise replaced after the map-owned rescue.
issues.resolution: The fresh port-5967 realtime probe observed 8 1gangtiegongchengche and 1 1gangtieyaosai at game loops 389 and 405 with requestStepsSent=0 and no debug or chat command.

issues.summary: The launcher now isolates API runs with a port-suffixed packed map when a previous run still holds the default packed-map file, and a fresh secondary client reached ready while the external SC2 process remained untouched.
issues.impact: None for the verified secondary-client path; old failed evidence remains historical and was not promoted to a runtime claim.
issues.resolution: Port 5967 reached ready=true and used thanson01.stage07.5967.packed.SC2Map without terminating the user's SC2 process.

issues.summary: Non-Iron runtime replacement declarations with one mapping were silently omitted from the generated Galaxy replacement body because PowerShell unwrapped the single-element JSON property before the count-based loop.
issues.impact: Before the fix, Coverts and Umojan worker replacements were declared in evidence but their generated runtime function bodies were empty; bridge-based structure/unit replacements still ran. The issue affected only generated single-element replacement lists.
issues.resolution: The launcher now normalizes runtimeReplacementList and substitutes the generated Galaxy body through explicit markers. Fresh Coverts and Umojan windows observe SCVC/CommandCenterC and SCVU/CommandCenterU; Pirate and Madness bridge targets also pass in fresh windows, all with zero same-window ScriptErrors.
